Eight signed roll phases per camera inspected. Body/fenders/glass/bed stay fixed. Tires remain seated and highlights roll; native hub aliases are ordinary angle sampling. Actual hierarchy audit additionally proves each independent wheel, fixed pivots, reverse quarter turns and absolute reset.
